title: First band personnel: Joe Guy and Louis Bacon
summary: Dance and Cootie sort through the 1942 band including trumpeters Joe Guy and Louis Bacon.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: There. Well, now, Cootie, we talked about your forming the band. But I didn't ask you the personnel on that first band. That's 1942.
No. I can't remember the personnel.
Well, let me -- I think I've got some of it here, so let's talk this over. I think Joe Guy was with you.
Well, let me ask you something about Joe Guy, now. He wasn't married to Billie at that time, was he?
Was he just a young kid coming up?
Yeah. In a way of speaking, yeah.
I mean, you didn't find him somewhere. He was around.
Yeah, he was around. I think he was down to Minton's.
Yeah. Well, I want to ask you about the trumpet. So then you had Louis Bacon.
Well, now, Louis Bacon used to --
-- sub with Duke sometimes, too, didn't he?
Didn't Louis Bacon play with Duke at one time?
Well -- and then the kind of singing he did. He sang ballads.
Well, then, tell me now, so you could use three trumpets. Yourself and these two. Well, how did that work out? Now, Joe Guy was a modernist.
And I also had another trumpeter. I had three trumpeters right then.
I don't know who it was.
Well, I may have, you know, maybe I didn't spot that and put that down. Well, so, with those three trumpeters, who would be playing first? Louis Bacon?
